title: The Creator Playbook Brands are Using to Print Millions (4 Formats)
description:
Building a lucrative creator business is easy... if you know where to start. Every video should begin with research into winning formats, angles and hooks to stop the scroll. Watch the full episode for the rest of your process.

In this episode Brian covers:
- Guinea Pig Content (trend testing)
- How to tell a compelling story
- Building desire and relatability through ungatekeeping
- Competitor callout and trust jacking
- The new creator community: Hit Makers
